title: Accessibility
description: How this site is built for accessibility, what is known to fall short, and how to report a barrier.
content_html:
Commitment

This site is built to be usable by everyone, including people using screen readers, keyboard navigation, magnification and other assistive technology. We target WCAG 2.1 Level AA.

What is implemented

Semantic structure. Headings follow a logical order, landmarks identify page regions, and lists, tables and forms use appropriate elements rather than styled substitutes.

Keyboard access. Every interactive element is reachable and operable by keyboard, with a visible focus indicator. A skip link at the top of each page jumps directly to main content.

Contrast. Text and interactive elements meet AA contrast requirements against their backgrounds. Colour is never the only means of conveying information — the signal accent always accompanies text or a shape, never replaces it.

Reduced motion. All motion — scroll reveals, counting statistics, the marquee strip, chromatogram animation — is disabled automatically when the operating system requests reduced motion.

Text alternatives. Informative images carry descriptive alternative text. Decorative graphics are hidden from assistive technology rather than announced as unlabelled images.

Responsive layout. Content reflows to 320 pixels and supports zoom to 200% without loss of function. Wide content such as data tables scrolls within its own container rather than forcing the page sideways.

Data tables. Specification and comparison tables use proper header associations so screen readers announce row and column context.

Known limitations

Long data tables. The research hub table is wide and requires horizontal scrolling on small screens. The same data is available in a linear form on individual monograph pages.

Sequence strings. Long peptide sequences are presented as continuous monospace text and can be verbose when read aloud character by character.

PDF documents. Certificates of Analysis are supplied as PDFs generated by analytical instrument software, and their accessibility is limited by that source. If you need the contents of a certificate in an accessible format, ask and we will provide it directly.

Reporting a barrier

If something on this site is not usable for you, tell us. Include the page, what you were trying to do, and the assistive technology you were using if relevant.

support@noviqpeptides.com

We aim to respond within five business days. Where a fix is straightforward we make it promptly; where it is not, we will tell you what we are doing and offer the information you needed by another route in the meantime.

Assessment

This statement reflects self-assessment against WCAG 2.1 AA rather than an independent audit. It will be updated as the site changes.

title: Cancellation Policy
description: When an order can be cancelled or changed, and what happens after dispatch.
content_html:
Before dispatch

Orders can be cancelled or amended at no cost at any point before dispatch. Email support@noviqpeptides.com with your order reference.

Because orders confirmed before 2:00 PM CT are dispatched the same day, the practical window is short. A cancellation request sent within a couple of hours of ordering will normally reach us in time; one sent the following morning usually will not.

Refunds for cancellations before dispatch are issued in full to the original payment method, typically within five business days.

After dispatch

Once a parcel is handed to the carrier we cannot recall it, and research materials cannot be returned to stock — a vial that has left our control has an unknown storage history and cannot be released again against our specification.

If a parcel has already shipped, the routes available are the damage and fulfilment-error provisions in our Shipping & Returns policy.

Recurring orders

Recurring orders can be paused, rescheduled, modified or cancelled at any time before the next order is generated, with no fee and no minimum commitment.

Notification is sent before each recurring order is prepared, which is the point to make changes.

Changes to an order

Before dispatch we can usually change quantity, variant, shipping address or add items. Adding items may change the shipping cost or trigger a volume break, and we will confirm the revised total before proceeding.

Cancellation by us

We may cancel an order, including after confirmation, where:

  • Stock proves unavailable
  • A pricing error is identified
  • We cannot verify the shipping destination
  • Supply would not comply with law applicable at the destination
  • The order appears fraudulent

In every case the order is refunded in full and we tell you why.

Backorders

Where an item is unavailable we contact you with the expected date and the choice of waiting, substituting, or cancelling that line. We do not hold an order open indefinitely without telling you.

Contact

support@noviqpeptides.com — include your order reference.

title: Privacy Policy
description: What data Noviq Peptides collects, why, how long it is kept, and the choices available to you.
content_html:
What we collect

Information you provide. Name, email address, shipping and billing address, and order contents when you place or request an order. Any information you include in an email to us.

Information collected automatically. Standard server request data — IP address, browser type, pages requested, timestamps — used for security and to understand which pages are useful.

Cart contents. Stored in your browser's local storage, on your device. Cart data is not transmitted to us until you submit an order.

What we do not collect

We do not collect health information, and we do not ask why you are purchasing a research material. We do not build behavioural profiles, and we do not sell or rent personal information to anyone, for any purpose.

Why we process it

  • To fulfil and support orders
  • To maintain lot traceability records, which we are obliged to keep and which serve your interests as well as ours
  • To respond to enquiries
  • To meet legal, tax and record-keeping requirements
  • To protect the site against abuse

How long we keep it

Order and lot-traceability records are retained for seven years, which reflects both tax requirements and the practical need to trace a certificate to an order long after the fact.

Email correspondence is retained for three years. Server logs are retained for 90 days.

Sharing

We share information only with:

  • Carriers, to deliver your order
  • Payment processors, who handle payment data directly — we do not store full payment card details
  • Professional advisers and authorities, where legally required

Every processor is bound by contract to use the information only for the service provided.

Cookies and local storage

We use the minimum necessary. Cart contents and site preferences are stored in your browser's local storage and remain on your device. We do not use third-party advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

Your choices

You may request access to the personal information we hold about you, request correction, request deletion (subject to our legal record-keeping obligations), or ask for a portable copy.

Write to support@noviqpeptides.com. We respond within 30 days.

Note that order and lot-traceability records cannot generally be deleted while retention obligations apply, and that deleting them would also remove your ability to trace a certificate to a past order.

Security

Data is transmitted over TLS and access to order records is restricted to staff who need it. No system is perfectly secure; we will notify affected individuals promptly if a breach materially affects them.

Children

The site is not directed to anyone under 21, and purchasers certify that they are 21 or older.

Changes

Material changes to this policy will be reflected in the revision date above.

Contact

support@noviqpeptides.com

title: Shipping & Returns
description: Dispatch times, packaging, damage claims and the return conditions that apply to research materials.
content_html:
Dispatch

Orders confirmed before 2:00 PM CT on a business day are dispatched the same day. Orders placed after the cutoff, at weekends, or on public holidays are dispatched the next business day.

Every shipment is tracked. Tracking details are sent when the parcel is handed to the carrier, not when the order is confirmed, so the two are usually a few hours apart.

Shipping cost

Free on orders over $250. Below that threshold, cost is calculated at confirmation based on destination and weight.

Packaging

Outer packaging is plain and unmarked. There are no product names, no compound names and no indication of contents on the exterior. The return address is a generic business address, and the billing descriptor is non-descriptive.

Vials ship in protective packaging appropriate to the material. Lyophilized peptides are stable at ambient temperature for the duration of normal transit; where a product genuinely requires cold chain, it is shipped accordingly and this is stated on the product page.

Receiving a shipment

Inspect on arrival, before the vial goes into storage:

  • The crimp seal should be intact and the stopper fully seated
  • The lyophilized cake should be uniform, not collapsed, melted or discoloured
  • The lot number on the vial should match the certificate supplied

Photograph anything unexpected before opening the vial. Once a vial is opened, distinguishing a shipping problem from a handling problem becomes difficult for everyone involved.

Damage and fulfilment errors

Report transit damage or an incorrect item within 72 hours of delivery, with photographs. We replace the affected item at no cost, including shipping. There is no restocking charge and no requirement to return a damaged vial.

Returns

Research materials cannot be returned once dispatched, and this is not a commercial preference. A vial that has left our control has an unknown storage history, and material with an unknown storage history cannot be released again against our specification. Accepting it back into stock would mean shipping a vial whose certificate no longer describes what is in it.

The exceptions, all covered above, are damage in transit, an incorrect item shipped, and material that fails to meet its published specification.

Unopened lab supplies and apparel may be returned within 30 days in original condition.

Out-of-specification material

If material does not meet the specification published on its Certificate of Analysis, we replace it or refund it in full, and we investigate the lot. Send the lot number and the basis of the finding — an independent analysis, a chromatogram, or a clear description of the discrepancy.

Address accuracy

We ship to the address supplied at confirmation. Changes are possible before dispatch; after handover to the carrier, redirection depends on the carrier's own process and is not guaranteed.

Restrictions

We ship only where these materials may lawfully be supplied for laboratory research use. Purchasers are responsible for compliance with the law applicable at the destination, including import requirements.

They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease, and they are not intended for administration to humans or to animals.

No information published by us — including compound monographs, comparisons, journal articles and Certificates of Analysis — constitutes medical, veterinary or clinical advice, or a recommendation for any use.

We retain lot records and make certificates available for the lots we release.

We are not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, including loss of data, loss of experimental results, or costs of substitute materials.

Nothing in these terms limits liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for fraud, or for any liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

8. Indemnity

You agree to indemnify us against claims arising from your use, handling, storage, disposal or onward supply of materials purchased from us, and from any breach of the certifications in section 3.

9. Intellectual property

Site content, including monographs, comparisons and journal articles, is our property and may not be reproduced commercially without permission. Reasonable citation with attribution is permitted and welcome.

10. Compliance

You are responsible for compliance with all laws applicable at your location, including import requirements, controlled-substance law and institutional policy. We supply only where these materials may lawfully be supplied for laboratory research use.

11. Changes
